name: CaseAntdFocusOutlineRingChildPart
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-focus-outline-ring-child-part" (interaction-states). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: label > span > [input.sr-only:focus-visible + span.box { outline: 3px solid rgb(145, 202, 255) }] — the focus ring as an OUTLINE state delta on a NESTED PART (antd Checkbox-inner, Radio-inner)
